tagline: A swirling column of plasma trapped in glass — where it all began
Fractal lightning burned into wood at 2,000 volts
A trash can that shoots flaming vortex rings across the yard
Mesmerizing tabletop fire tornado — dead simple to build
The speaker cone is literally lightning
Sound waves visualized as a dancing wall of fire
Actual levitation with ultrasonic transducers — no tricks
Strobe-synced water droplets that appear frozen — or flowing upward
A magnetic liquid that spikes, morphs, and dances like a living creature
Bend glass, fill with gas, apply voltage — real neon
A hidden magnet draws infinite geometric patterns in sand
A coffee table that visualizes cosmic radiation in real time
256 electromagnetic pixels — like an old airport departure board you built yourself
